title: Where the 2019 earthquake stopped
text: The rupture of the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquake ended near the Garlock Fault. The Garlock Fault west of the rupture's end was unclamped, meaning the force pressing its two sides together had eased. Soon afterward, the Garlock Fault began slowly creeping, slipping about 2 centimeters at the surface.
